tutorial.title: First Shift
tutorial.step1: This is a closed-off city. Tap any block to place the Command Center there.
tutorial.step2: A hero is ready to work. Swipe across the blocks next to the center: heroes will go and clear them.
tutorial.step3: Empty blocks mean nothing is nearby. Then heroes clear the neighbors by themselves.
tutorial.step4: A number counts only the 8 blocks around it. Tap it: only one neighbor is closed, so the nest is there. Hold that block and mark it «Danger».
tutorial.step5: Tap both numbers. They share one closed neighbor, and the nest can only be there. So the other block is safe. Dig it.
tutorial.step6: Before going near the nest, stock up on Energy. Build a Microreactor: it makes Energy by itself, no hero has to sit inside.
tutorial.step7: Your heroes are ready. Tap the red mark to open the nest. It is not a loss, it is the start of a fight: heroes fight by themselves.
tutorial.step8: The hero won and took the adaptant's arm. The more trophies, the stronger they get.
tutorial.step9: A light-blue number means a find nearby. Clear a block next to it and open the cache.
tutorial.final.title: You are ready for the shift
tutorial.final.line1: A number shows how many of that are nearby.
tutorial.final.line2: A long press puts a «Danger» or «Not sure» mark. A swipe goes around it.
tutorial.final.line3: A red mark means danger. Open it when your heroes are ready.
